text_block_list.text:
One day in the library, Silence Suzuka
was being tutored by Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Air Groove?
Would it be alright if I went for a run to clear my head—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I won't let you escape.
I highly doubt you'd ever return from "clearing your head."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Your exams are coming right up, aren't they? If you don't get moving,
you'll never make it through this mountain of reference books.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: The mountains...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The mountains... That's true, running in the mountains
sounds like it'd feel great—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh? Where am I...?
Air Groove...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: She's gone...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Well then—alright.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: The start...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haah...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Incredible.
I can't even see the peak of this mountain.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Meaning... all-you-can-run...?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: —Fufu!
—Ka!
"Suzuka! Hey, Suzuka!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: H-Huh... What happened to the mountain from earlier...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so you were listening after all?
Now, for geography, we start with memorizing the names of mountains and rivers...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Listen to this, Air Groove.
I was running endlessly up a mountain with no summit in sight—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...You're talking about a dream?!
So you really were asleep!

Afterward, Silence Suzuka's running form
had improved tremendously.
